description: A Voice for the Voiceless I’m Representative Wengay "Newt" Newton, and I’m running to represent Florida House District 62. With 15 years of experience in public service, I bring proven legislative leadership and the strong relationships in Tallahassee necessary to deliver real results for our community. I’ve built the bridges that matter — now I’m ready to return and move our district forward. It would be an honor and a privilege to serve you once again. 📅 Election Day: August 18th, 2026.
title: Wengay Newton for the Florida House District 62. | State Representatives | St. Petersburg, FL, USA
